interface: 30-s observed X; EEG S and O each reconstruct native 200-Hz voltage; Hb S and O each jointly reconstruct 10-Hz HbO/HbR. Each branch/site pays one ID every 2 s. Native physical coordinate uses the original fixed training scale. Four-branch decoding accepts the paid integers, frozen state and fixed montage information.
historical_scope: four participants, one per library, excluded from this entire selection and new scoring, previously seen in historical G1 validation
frozen_scale_exposure: The original G0 training scales and original Wiener prior used all 60 training subjects, including train people later held from these dictionary, gain, or readout fits. New word fits/readout evaluation are grouped by person. The 4 reserved people were previously seen in historical G1 validation only.
new_selection_panel: 400 native EEG arrays, 17040 position-windows, 249675 complete local 2s EEG patches; 15360 Hb position-windows for spectral allocation; local EEG-to-Hb diagnostic has separate support.

development.EEG: actual hard codes replay, waveform gain and raw single-ID/difficult-event requirements failed
development.Hb: all original numeric checks passed on both retained development panels; difficult opposing-component amplitudes still fail

results.exchange_balanced_actual_words: Both seed107/211 improve raw theta and alpha over the original dataset/site/input-energy background. Full unbalanced waveform words and a role-only label fail. Local envelope readout worsens. Site-, library-, member- and template-transfer failures are retained.
results.natural_context: 120 real pairs in 60 training subjects and 4850 valid physical position pairs. The six mean normalized attribute changes pass the prespecified tolerance; single-location tails and dataset-specific negative gains remain.
results.waveform: Integer replacement of a matched finite-band continuous trajectory causes substantial additional error, especially EEG-S. Preselected CP5, FC2 and F7 voltage-event tails remain.
results.Hb_spectral: Protected frozen-ID readout improves joint S/O NMSE from .214425 to .202280, 52 of 60 people improve. Crop-level peak timing remains wrong by 8.8 and 10.8 s in independent REFED records. Original visual rejection applies.
results.cross_seed_templates: Seed107/211 fit-member one-to-one alignment, by frozen branch and frequency, agrees on 21.0%/26.4% of held S/O words vs about 0.1% chance. One direction loses S-alpha and O-theta. Half-fit controls show both decrease in cell support and additional transfer error.
results.event_coding: Resolving the first quartile of X-visible spatially weighted quantization errors with continuous per-event waveforms passes the train waveform screen. Finite 14-bit words for those events do not: ordinary means X/S/O .611765/.715355/.677571. An exhaustive training-example nearest waveform, itself only a diagnostic, gives .578378/.684869/.639755.
results.multiple_ID_rate: An additional three 8-bit residual words per selected event raise total EEG payload to 19.993 bit/s per native site. X/S/O .50304/.61587/.55735. S, per-dataset, RMS and frequency gates fail. Full tuple training support for events falls to 0% in S and 0.252% in O.
results.phase_readout: Target-informed per-window even+odd low-frequency Hb correction can reach .021943 joint S/O NMSE. A fit-person-only frozen correction reaches .200840; Single-Trial S-HbO P99 .722366 exceeds .720568, and independent event examples remain poor.
results.fixed_integer_montage_synthesis: The same balanced words with a full montage complex spectral decoder produce X/S/O .620800/.665468/.657010. The same-electrode two-stream control gives .651005/.695437/.684830. S RMS gain .5902 and waveform gates fail despite lower NMSE.

public_exposure: New experiments used the existing development-authorized training partition, with held training people for scoring. The prior completed four-branch development evaluation used 16 people. None of the four reserved people was used for any new fit, selection or score. Historical G1 validation already included them. No project-protected test data were read.
joint_confirmation: No finite four-branch candidate cleared the joint waveform, single-ID and repeated-event visual gates. The second seed replicated the EEG tagged dictionary findings. The reserved confirmation panel remains unscored for this selection.
scope_of_negative_evidence: Stop this generation of independent atomic waveform dictionaries, the tested sparse-event residual codes and fixed spectral allocation heads. The evidence establishes a persistent empirical failure across the specified frozen encoders, decoders, rates, panels and original thresholds. It does not establish a universal impossibility theorem.
restoration: Start from either verified development/training inference bundle or from the new fold0 pattern reference. New investigations should compare to the immutable equal-support masks, scales, sample identities, event charts, raw single-word readouts and stored integer payloads in this index. Preserve all four libraries and hard windows.
